title: Northwind Voyager statement credit terms
summary: The card's own credit terms: 300 travel credit per cardmember year, resetting on the account anniversary; curated hotel credit 500 per calendar year, 250 per booking, two-night minimum; dining credit 150 per half year; ride credit 10 per month through September 30, 2027; trusted-traveler fee credit 120 every four years from the last use; streaming credit 20 per quarter with carry-over up to 20; and a choice between a 200 yearly lifestyle credit and a 25 monthly wellness credit.

title: Northwind Voyager Guide to Benefits
summary: The card's own guide. Annual travel credit. Phone protection included. Rental cover is primary with a higher cap and replaces the network's secondary cover. No mention of a lounge pass.
